```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Test Case for Computing Battery ETA from Battery History",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-120"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is initialized and connected to battery amount sensor"],
    "inputs": {"battery_history": "array of battery amounts"},
    "steps": [
      "Trigger the GUI to compute the battery ETA",
      "Verify the GUI displays the computed ETA"
    ],
    "expected": ["The GUI correctly displays the battery ETA based on the provided battery history"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Test Case for Low Battery Alarm Activation",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-122"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"battery_level": "below threshold indicating low battery"},
    "steps": [
      "Allow the GUI to update the battery status",
      "Check if the 'low battery' alarm is triggered",
      "Verify the alarm is low priority"
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'low battery' alarm is triggered and remains low priority when the battery level is below the low battery threshold"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Test Case for Critically Low Battery Alarm Activation",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-124"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"battery_level": "below threshold indicating critically low battery"},
    "steps": [
      "Allow the GUI to update the battery status",
      "Check if the 'critically low battery' alarm is triggered",
      "Verify the alarm is high priority"
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'critically low battery' alarm is triggered and remains high priority when the battery level is below the critically low threshold"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Test Case for Battery Failure Alarm Activation",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-129"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"battery_status": "absent, unavailable, or unchargeable"},
    "steps": [
      "Allow the GUI to update the battery status",
      "Check if the 'battery failure' alarm is triggered",
      "Verify the alarm is activated"
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'battery failure' alarm is triggered when the battery is absent, unavailable, or unchargeable"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Boundary Test Case for Low Battery Alarm Activation",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-122"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"battery_level": "at the low battery threshold"},
    "steps": [
      "Allow the GUI to update the battery status",
      "Check if the 'low battery' alarm is triggered",
      "Verify the alarm is low priority and triggers at the threshold"
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'low battery' alarm is triggered at the threshold and remains low priority"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Boundary Test Case for Critically Low Battery Alarm Activation",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-124"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"battery_level": "at the critically low threshold"},
    "steps": [
      "Allow the GUI to update the battery status",
      "Check if the 'critically low battery' alarm is triggered",
      "Verify the alarm is high priority and triggers at the threshold"
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'critically low battery' alarm is triggered at the threshold and remains high priority"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-007",
    "title": "Negative Test Case for Low Battery Alarm Activation",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-122"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"battery_level": "above low battery threshold"},
    "steps": [
      "Allow the GUI to update the battery status",
      "Verify the 'low battery' alarm is not triggered"
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'low battery' alarm is not triggered when the battery level is above the low battery threshold"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-008",
    "title": "Negative Test Case for Critically Low Battery Alarm Activation",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-124"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"battery_status": "present, available, and chargeable"},
    "steps": [
      "Allow the GUI to update the battery status",
      "Verify the 'critically low battery' alarm is not triggered"
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'critically low battery' alarm is not triggered when the battery is present, available, and chargeable"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-009",
    "title": "Test Case for Battery Status Unchanged on No Input",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-120"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"no_input": true},
    "steps": [
      "Allow the GUI to remain idle without any input",
      "Verify the displayed battery ETA does not change"
    ],
    "expected": ["The displayed battery ETA remains stable without any new input"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-100",
    "title": "Test Case for Battery Failure Alarm with False Sensor Data",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-129"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["GUI is connected to battery amount sensor and displays current battery status"],
    "inputs": {"battery_status": "fake unavailable, unchargeable data"},
    "steps": [
      "Simulate the GUI receiving false battery sensor data",
      "Verify the 'battery failure' alarm is not triggered"
    ],
    "expected": ["The 'battery failure' alarm is not triggered when the GUI receives false sensor data indicating battery is unavailable or unchargeable"]
  }
]
```
